split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate commits; positions 1 to 4 are normative, position 5 is determinative
split_justification.reason: The owner permitted splitting the normative part across several commits after a context break left finished work uncommitted. Each position is coherent on its own and is committed only when its own tests and the affected gate modes are green, so no position depends on a later one to be correct.
condition_per_commit: the position is self contained: it introduces no reference to an artifact a later position creates
the full tooling test suite passes
the configuration loader binding check passes
no position leaves the guard in a state where it cannot decide
split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.
